# Community conduct

Participate respectfully and discuss technical ideas on their merits. Do not
harass, discriminate, threaten, impersonate others or disclose private
information. Obtain permission before posting another person's meeting data,
voice or identifying information.

Maintainers may remove inappropriate content, restrict participation and
close discussions to protect contributors. Report conduct concerns through
an available private maintainer contact rather than publishing sensitive
details. This repository does not invent an email address or organization.
